answers.answer: Ask Meadow Works to resend the invoice and photos by email. Ask the tenant to confirm the fix by email. Update the landlord by email, saying no amount can be given yet.

answers.answer: No. This is routine work and there is no invoice discrepancy yet.

args.body: Hi Kendall, Meadow Works emailed today to say they attended the shower at Willowmere Road, found a problem with the mixer, cleaned and greased it, and that hot and cold are now both running. They say photos and an invoice were attached, but the attachments did not reach us, so we haven't seen the invoice or the amount and can't tell you the cost yet. We have asked them to resend it and are checking with the tenant that the shower works. We'll update you once we have the invoice, by Wednesday 4 June.
